diagnosis.source: writer self-critique informed by outcome-level controller feedback
diagnosis.representation_failure: The round-01 staircase gave two local diagnostic blocks priority over the system-level outcome.
diagnosis.selection_failure: Too many absolute values received equal rhetorical weight, so the abstract exposed evidence without a sufficiently strong contribution hierarchy.
diagnosis.preserved_strength: Adjacent mechanism-to-test bindings made the role of component evidence recoverable.
diagnosis.repair_target: Preserve local bindings while establishing the aggregate contribution earlier and reducing each binding to a discriminative numeric anchor.

observations: In the selected round-01 realization, the headline 1.5B result followed two dense local result blocks.
Nearly every evidence sentence carried several absolute values, making local details compete with the contribution-level comparison.
The useful part of the staircase was adjacency between a mechanism and its diagnostic evidence, not its low-to-high ordering.

preconditions: The evidence contains a system-level comparative result and component-relevant diagnostic results.
The system result can be stated without an exhaustive baseline table.
Local evidence can be compressed without changing its direction or scope.
operation_contract.transformation: State the joint problem and architecture, place one system-level comparative anchor by the third sentence, then attach one selectively compressed diagnostic anchor to each mechanism role. Preserve an explicit non-dominance statement for SISO versus MIMO and end with retrieval and scale scope gates.
operation_contract.rejection_rule: Reject if the early anchor implies universal dominance, if compression removes the direction of a diagnostic comparison, if a number is detached from its setting, or if the scope gates disappear.

predicted_effects: Earlier recovery of the main language-model contribution.
Mechanism-result coherence comparable to the original staircase.
Less table-like prose because each local block uses only its most discriminative contrast.
Clearer distinction between MIMO's quality benefit and SISO's latency advantage.
failure_modes: Compressing the baseline table may weaken readers' sense of comparative margin.
A headline result before local validation may make the architecture sound less mechanistically motivated.
Selective anchors may omit a component detail that some evaluators consider central.
falsification_tests: Compare with a binding-detached control containing the same factual units, numeric anchors, and similar length; falsify the binding claim if mechanism-test recoverability does not decline in the control.
Compare with the round-01 staircase; falsify the salience repair if contribution identification is not earlier or numeric-load judgments do not improve.
Reject if any blind evaluator finds that compression changed a comparison's scope or factual meaning.

content_evidence_boundary.strategy_induction: The early anchor, selective numeric budget, and adjacency rule are writer-invented operations. The controller supplied outcome failures, not this repair.
content_evidence_boundary.required_content_evidence: All architecture components, settings, comparisons, diagnostic results, latency tradeoffs, retrieval claims, and scale boundaries must map to the permitted chip.
content_evidence_boundary.feedback_role: Controller feedback motivates diagnosis only and is not evidence for paper content.
prohibited: claiming exact component causality for aggregate gains
claiming MIMO is the fastest path

observations: Round-01 writer and controller judgments both found the adjacent local bindings functionally coherent.
The remaining uncertainty is whether that coherence requires the original staircase order and numeric density.

preconditions: Local attribution is prioritized over early aggregate salience.
operation_contract.transformation: Present mechanism and diagnostic evidence in three ascending adjacent steps, then state the aggregate tradeoff and limitation.
operation_contract.rejection_rule: Reject if the main result arrives too late for the communication context or the abstract reads as a numeric catalog.

predicted_effects: Lower early system-level salience than S5.
Potentially higher numeric burden than S5.
failure_modes: Local evidence can obscure the contribution hierarchy.
Readers may retain a measurement table instead of the architectural idea.
falsification_tests: Compare with S5 at a matched word budget; reject the incumbent locally if S5 preserves coherence while improving salience and compression.

content_evidence_boundary.strategy_induction: This is the round-01 incumbent, retained as posterior mass rather than assumed optimal.
content_evidence_boundary.required_content_evidence: Every local binding and aggregate result must remain chip-grounded.
prohibited: treating the controller's coherence judgment as transfer evidence
promoting the strategy without a counterfactual

observations: A fixed recurrent state has a documented retrieval boundary.
A mitigation exists but adds attention-related cost.
Leading with this contrast may calibrate the positive results differently from either a result ledger or mechanism staircase.

preconditions: A central architectural promise has a supported limitation.
A supported mitigation has a supported cost.
operation_contract.transformation: Open with the promise-boundary contrast, state mitigation and cost, then introduce the architecture and positive evidence before returning to a conditional conclusion.
operation_contract.rejection_rule: Reject if the opening hides the contribution, repeats the caveat, or implies that hybrid attention is free.

predicted_effects: A surface and information order distinct from S5.
failure_modes: The limitation can dominate a short word budget.
falsification_tests: Compare contribution identification and boundedness with S5; reject if the early boundary reduces salience without improving calibration.

content_evidence_boundary.strategy_induction: The contrast loop remains a writer-proposed alternative and is not attributed to an expert trace.
content_evidence_boundary.required_content_evidence: The limitation, mitigation, cost, method, and all positive results must be separately grounded in the chip.
prohibited: claiming hybrid attention eliminates retrieval failures

counterfactual_control.targeted_operation: S5 early system anchor plus adjacent selective mechanism-test bindings
counterfactual_control.intervention: List all mechanisms together, group evaluations separately in a non-mechanism order, and move the aggregate quality result behind latency, ablation, and retrieval.
counterfactual_control.prediction: The control will make the aggregate contribution later and the local component-test mapping less immediately recoverable while preserving factual support.
